Go: Most-asked coding language for SRE/platform/infra roles; many interviews include a Go or Python coding round.
A Tour of Go (go.dev/tour) -> 'Learn Go with Tests' (free book) -> Go by Example. ~4-6 weeks part-time.
Write a small Go CLI/K8s operator (e.g. Azure cost-cleanup or a Kubernetes controller that labels idle namespaces); publish on GitHub.
GitHub Actions: Second most common CI/CD after Jenkins/ADO; startups default to it.
GitHub Docs 'Learn GitHub Actions' + GitHub Skills courses (free). ~1 week.
Port one of your Azure DevOps pipelines (Bicep what-if + deploy with OIDC federated credentials) to GitHub Actions; public repo.
Helm: Standard way to package K8s apps; often 'required' for platform/SRE.
Helm chart for a sample app with values per env; deploy to AKS via pipeline.
Argo CD: GitOps is the default K8s deploy pattern at modern shops.
Argo CD 'Getting Started' + Akuity/Codefresh GitOps cert (free).
App-of-apps repo deploying the Helm chart to AKS/kind with Argo CD.
Datadog: Most common commercial observability tool in JDs.
Instrument a sample app; dashboards + SLO monitors; add screenshots to portfolio.
OpenTelemetry: Add OTel tracing to the sample app exporting to Grafana/Azure Monitor.
SRE/SLOs: Google SRE Book + SRE Workbook chapters on SLOs (free online).
Define SLOs + burn-rate alerts for a production service in Azure Monitor; write it up (no confidential data).
Kafka: Event streaming shows up in platform roles.
Okta: Corporate identity roles ask for Okta specifically.
Okta Developer docs + free Okta Workforce trial; Okta Certified Professional.
Okta tenant with SAML/OIDC app + SCIM provisioning to a test app; write-up.
SAML/OIDC/OAuth: oauth.com 'OAuth 2.0 Simplified' + Microsoft identity platform docs.
Demo app using Entra ID OIDC + workload identity federation; explain flows in README.
Conditional Access/Zero Trust: You already run Entra ID - this is a short hop.
Microsoft Learn SC-300 path (Identity and Access Administrator).
Get SC-300 certified; document a Conditional Access baseline.
OPA/Rego/Policy engines: Policy-as-code for K8s/Terraform in security/platform roles.
Gatekeeper/Kyverno policies on AKS + conftest on Terraform/Bicep in CI.
Palo Alto/Fortinet firewalls: Network-security roles want a named NGFW vendor.
Palo Alto Beacon free courses (PCNSA prep).
PCNSA cert, or lab VM-Series in Azure hub-and-spoke.
Zscaler/Cloudflare: Zscaler Academy (free ZDTA) / Cloudflare Learning Center.
BGP/routing protocols: Cisco/Juniper free BGP labs, Azure Route Server + VPN BGP docs.
Azure VPN with BGP lab write-up.
SIEM/Sentinel: Security engineering roles; Sentinel fits your Azure stack.
Sentinel workspace with analytics rules on Azure activity logs.
CSPM/CNAPP (Wiz, Prisma): Wiz/Prisma free webinars; Defender for Cloud (you have) maps directly.
Write-up of Defender CSPM posture work.
Python software engineering: Many SRE roles want Python as engineering, not scripts (tests, packaging, typing).
'Python for DevOps' (O'Reilly) + pytest docs; build with tests + CI.
Publish a tested Python CLI (e.g. Azure cost reporter) on PyPI/GitHub.
CKA/CKAD cert: Frequently 'preferred'; cheap signal for K8s depth.
KodeKloud CKA course + killer.sh simulator. ~6-8 weeks.
AWS DevOps/SA Pro cert: Preferred cert in AWS-heavy SRE roles.
Terraform Cloud/Enterprise: HashiCorp Terraform Associate (003) + HCP Terraform tutorials.
MLOps: Fast-growing area adjacent to your platform skills.
Microsoft Learn DP-100 / Azure ML MLOps; 'Made With ML' MLOps course (free).
Azure ML pipeline + model deployment via Bicep and Azure DevOps.
LLM/GenAI: AI platform roles; you already use Claude Code/MCP.
Microsoft Learn AI-102 / Azure OpenAI; Anthropic & OpenAI docs.
Deploy a secure RAG/agent stack on Azure (private endpoints, Key Vault, APIM) with Bicep - very marketable.
GPU: NVIDIA DLI free courses; AKS GPU node pools docs.
AKS GPU node pool + model serving demo.
Linux internals/performance: Brendan Gregg 'Systems Performance' + Linux perf tools.
Capacity planning: SRE roles list it; you have right-sizing evidence.
Add a capacity-planning bullet if you've done forecasting.
Backstage/IDP: backstage.io docs; CNCF Platform Engineering whitepaper.
Backstage template that provisions your Bicep modules.
Chaos engineering: Chaos Studio experiment on a test environment.
Java: Some infra roles want JVM experience.
Pulumi: Port a Bicep module to Pulumi (C#/Python).
Power BI: Most-requested BI tool in analyst roles.
Microsoft Learn PL-300 path (free) -> PL-300 cert.
Publish a dashboard on public data with a short write-up.
Tableau: Common BI tool in analyst roles.
A Tableau Public viz linked from your resume.
SQL: Asked in almost every analyst interview.
SQLBolt, Mode SQL tutorial, LeetCode/StrataScratch SQL.
A query portfolio on a public dataset (GitHub).
Process mapping/BPMN: A before/after process map for a real process.
Salesforce: CRM BA roles ask for it.
Salesforce Trailhead (free) -> Administrator / Business Analyst cert.
Generative AI/Copilot: Microsoft Copilot / ChatGPT for analysts courses; prompt engineering guides.
A documented AI-assisted analysis or automation.
